SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.prototype, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Ni'
  AND m.number_of_elements > 1
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.number_of_elements = 2
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND ABS(c.atomic_fraction - 0.75) < 1e-6
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND ABS(c.atomic_fraction - 0.25) < 1e-6
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Co'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.crystal_system = 'cubic'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Al'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.space_group_number
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.space_group_number = 221
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Ti'
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Pt'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Ni'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Al'
)
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Ga'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Fe'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT c.element, c.site_label
FROM composition c
WHERE c.site_label = 'A-site'
ORDER BY c.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system
FROM material_entry m
ORDER BY m.chemical_system, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht, s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND LOWER(s.crystal_system) = 'cubic'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'W'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ni'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.chemical_system, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0
ORDER BY m.chemical_system ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  c.element,
  c.atomic_fraction,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Al'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND m.number_of_elements > 1
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = FALSE
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Co'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a >= 3.5
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.01
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ti'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE m.chemical_system = 'Al-Ni'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND s.lattice_a < 3.6
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Nb'
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Sc'
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.chemical_system NOT IN ('Al-Ni', 'Ni-Al')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site, COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS l12_compound_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY l12_compound_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a >= 4.0
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  c.element,
  c.atomic_fraction,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Pd'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Cu'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    c.site_label = 'B-site'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.volume_per_atom <= 12
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ir'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.chemical_system, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.number_of_elements = 2
ORDER BY m.chemical_system, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY s.lattice_a DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Ni'
  )
  AND (ps.is_stable = TRUE OR ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05)
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ca.element AS a_site,
       ca.atomic_fraction AS a_site_atomic_fraction,
       cb.element AS b_site,
       cb.atomic_fraction AS b_site_atomic_fraction,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition ca ON ca.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition cb ON cb.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ca.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND cb.site_label = 'B-site'
ORDER BY ca.element, cb.element, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site,
       AVG(s.lattice_a) AS avg_lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY c.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.3
  AND s.lattice_a BETWEEN 3.5 AND 3.7
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group, cp.property_name, cp.value, cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND cp.value >= 180.0
    AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_a_diff_from_ni3al, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Co'
  AND c.atomic_fraction >= 0.5
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       c.element AS b_site,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND c.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS shear_modulus, cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'shear_modulus'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ni'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
    AND c.site_label = 'A-site'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a BETWEEN 3.50 AND 3.60
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY cp.value DESC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp_c11.value AS C11,
    cp_c12.value AS C12,
    cp_c44.value AS C44,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1.0
            ELSE 1.0 / (1.0 + GREATEST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0))
        END
        *
        (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)))
        *
        CASE
            WHEN cp_c11.value > cp_c12.value AND cp_c44.value > 0 THEN
                (cp_c11.value - cp_c12.value + cp_c44.value) / (cp_c11.value + cp_c12.value + cp_c44.value)
            ELSE 0.0
        END
    ) AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c11.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
    AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c12.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
    AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c44.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
    AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'

    m.source_db,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.crystal_system,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.lattice_a,
    s.lattice_b,
    s.lattice_c,
    s.volume_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND calc.functional = 'GGA-PBE'
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable,
    cp.property_name,
    cp.tensor_component,
    cp.value
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE c.element = 'Fe'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND (
      cp.property_name IN ('C11', 'C12', 'C44')
      OR cp.tensor_component IN ('C11', 'C12', 'C44')
  )
ORDER BY m.formula, cp.property_name, cp.tensor_component
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.value >= 160
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  c_a.element AS a_site,
  c_a.atomic_fraction AS a_site_atomic_fraction,
  c_b.element AS b_site,
  c_b.atomic_fraction AS b_site_atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_a.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND c_b.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
ORDER BY m.formula, c_a.element, c_b.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.energy_above_hull = 0
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)(Sc|Ti|V|Cr|Mn|Fe|Co|Ni|Cu|Zn|Y|Zr|Nb|Mo|Tc|Ru|Rh|Pd|Ag|Cd|Hf|Ta|W|Re|Os|Ir|Pt|Au|Hg|Rf|Db|Sg|Bh|Hs|Mt|Ds|Rg|Cn)(-|$)'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp_c11.value AS C11,
  cp_c12.value AS C12,
  cp_c44.value AS C44
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.number_of_elements >= 2
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp_c11.value > cp_c12.value
  AND cp_c44.value > 0
ORDER BY
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC,
  ps.energy_above_hull ASC,
  cp_c44.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0
  AND m.number_of_elements >= 2
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  (
    0.5 * CASE
      WHEN ps.is_stable THEN 1.0
      ELSE GREATEST(0.0, 1.0 - ps.energy_above_hull / 0.1)
    END
    + 0.3 * GREATEST(0.0, 1.0 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.1)
    + 0.2 * (cp.value / 300.0)
  ) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, lattice_diff ASC, cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND (
      EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM composition c
          WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
            AND c.element = 'Ni'
      )
      OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM composition c
          WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
            AND c.element = 'Co'
      )
  )
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT m.chemical_system,
       m.formula,
       COUNT(*) AS count,
       AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS count,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS stable_percentage
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
GROUP BY m.chemical_system, m.formula
ORDER BY stable_percentage DESC, avg_energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable

JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC, cp.value DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,

       ps.energy_above_hull,

JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c
      WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
        AND c.element = 'Co'
  )

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE
    (m.formula = 'Co3Ti' OR m.reduced_formula = 'Co3Ti')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'Q1: negative formation energy / stable hull'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0.001 THEN 'Q2: negative formation energy / metastable hull'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom >= 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'Q3: positive formation energy / stable hull'
    ELSE 'Q4: positive formation energy / metastable hull'
  END AS stability_quadrant
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY stability_quadrant, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
    ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND m.chemical_system NOT IN ('Al-Ni', 'Ni-Al')
ORDER BY lattice_diff ASC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN substring(m.formula FROM '^([A-Z][a-z]?)') IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn') THEN '3d_transition_metal_A_site'
    WHEN substring(m.formula FROM '^([A-Z][a-z]?)') IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd', 'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg') THEN '4d_5d_transition_metal_A_site'
  END AS a_site_period_group,
  substring(m.formula FROM '^([A-Z][a-z]?)') AS a_site,
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND substring(m.formula FROM '^([A-Z][a-z]?)') IN (
    'Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn',
    'Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
    'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg'
  )
ORDER BY a_site_period_group ASC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.is_stable,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < (
      SELECT ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN phase_stability ps_ref ON ps_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      WHERE m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al'
      ORDER BY ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
      LIMIT 1
  )
  AND cp.value > (
      SELECT cp_ref.value
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN calculated_property cp_ref ON cp_ref.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id
           AND cp_ref.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
      WHERE m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al'
      ORDER BY cp_ref.value DESC
      LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY cp.value DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.is_stable, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    1.0 / (1.0 + GREATEST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.0)) AS stability_score,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)) AS lattice_matching_score,
    cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus,
    cp_bm.value AS elastic_score,
    (
        1.0 / (1.0 + GREATEST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.0))
        * 1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57))
        * cp_bm.value
    ) AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY composite_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  substring(m.formula FROM '^[A-Z][a-z]?') AS a_site,
  AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_enthalpy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
GROUP BY substring(m.formula FROM '^[A-Z][a-z]?')
ORDER BY avg_formation_enthalpy_per_atom ASC

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m

WHERE s.prototype = 'L12'
   OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.prototype

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

FROM material_entry m

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula

WHERE EXISTS (

    FROM composition c_ni
    WHERE c_ni.entry_id = m.entry_id

    FROM composition c_al
    WHERE c_al.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c_al.element = 'Al'

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1.0
    ELSE 1.0 / (1.0 + GREATEST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0))
  END AS stability_score,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)) AS lattice_match_score,
  cp_c11.value AS "C11",
  cp_c12.value AS "C12",
  cp_c44.value AS "C44",
  (cp_c11.value + cp_c12.value + cp_c44.value) / 3.0 AS elastic_score,
  (
    CASE
      WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1.0
      ELSE 1.0 / (1.0 + GREATEST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0))
    END
    * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)))
    * ((cp_c11.value + cp_c12.value + cp_c44.value) / 3.0)
  ) AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
  AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
  AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
  AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL

    cp_c11.value AS C11,

    cp_c44.value AS C44,
    CASE
        WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1.0
        ELSE 1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull)
    END AS stability_score,
    1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)) AS lattice_matching_score,
    ((cp_c11.value + 2.0 * cp_c12.value) / 3.0 + cp_c44.value) / 2.0 AS elastic_score,

        * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)))

    ) AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c11.property_name = 'C11'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system, s.lattice_a

SELECT c.element AS a_site, COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS l12_compound_count

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a

SELECT DISTINCT

SELECT m.formula

SELECT DISTINCT

SELECT m.formula

SELECT m.chemical_system, m.formula

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, cp_eh.value AS energy_above_hull

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE m.number_of_elements = 2
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY m.chemical_system, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,

FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12'

ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable

SELECT m.formula, AVG(s.lattice_a) AS avg_lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
GROUP BY m.formula

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m

JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.formula LIKE 'Co3%'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE m.formula LIKE '%Al%'
   OR m.formula LIKE '%Ti%'

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS shear_modulus, cp.unit

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m

WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE

SELECT DISTINCT

FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.formula IN ('Co3Ti', 'Ni3Al')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS stable_l12_al_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = FALSE) AS unstable_l12_al_count
FROM material_entry m

  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Al'
  )
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = FALSE
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS b_site, COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS stable_l12_compound_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id

GROUP BY c.element

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE calc.functional = 'GGA-PBE'
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS mismatch
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.property_name, cp.tensor_component, cp.value, cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id

  )
ORDER BY m.formula, cp.property_name, cp.tensor_component
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.value >= 160
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_a.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND c_b.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.energy_above_hull = 0
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)(Sc|Ti|V|Cr|Mn|Fe|Co|Ni|Cu|Zn|Y|Zr|Nb|Mo|Tc|Ru|Rh|Pd|Ag|Cd|Hf|Ta|W|Re|Os|Ir|Pt|Au|Hg)(-|$)'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  cp_stab.value AS phase_stability,
  cp_mis.value AS lattice_diff,
  cp_c11.value AS C11,
  cp_c12.value AS C12,
  cp_c44.value AS C44
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_stab ON cp_stab.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_stab.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
JOIN calculated_property cp_mis ON cp_mis.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_mis.property_name = 'lattice_mismatch'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c11.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
  AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c12.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
  AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c44.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
  AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
WHERE calc.calculation_type = 'L12'
ORDER BY cp_stab.value ASC, ABS(cp_mis.value) ASC, cp_c44.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_a_mismatch_to_ni3al
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND m.formula <> 'Ni3Al'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  cp_stability.value AS energy_above_hull,
  ABS(cp_lattice.value - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp_bulk.value AS bulk_modulus,
  (
    0.4 * (1.0 / (1.0 + cp_stability.value)) +
    0.3 * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(cp_lattice.value - 3.57))) +
    0.3 * (cp_bulk.value / 300.0)
  ) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc_stability ON calc_stability.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_stability ON cp_stability.calculation_id = calc_stability.calculation_id
JOIN calculation calc_lattice ON calc_lattice.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_lattice ON cp_lattice.calculation_id = calc_lattice.calculation_id
JOIN calculation calc_bulk ON calc_bulk.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bulk ON cp_bulk.calculation_id = calc_bulk.calculation_id
WHERE cp_stability.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
  AND cp_lattice.property_name = 'lattice_a'
  AND cp_bulk.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND (
    m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)Ni(-|$)'
    OR m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)Co(-|$)'
  )
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  m.chemical_system,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS material_count,
  AVG(cp.value) FILTER (WHERE cp.property_name = 'energy_above_hull') AS avg_energy_above_hull,
  AVG(cp.value) FILTER (WHERE cp.property_name = 'formation_energy_per_atom') AS avg_eform
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE m.number_of_elements = 2
  AND cp.property_name IN ('energy_above_hull', 'formation_energy_per_atom')
GROUP BY m.chemical_system
ORDER BY avg_energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST, material_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC, cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ABS(cp_a.value - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp_c11.value AS "C11",
    cp_c12.value AS "C12",
    cp_c44.value AS "C44",
    (cp_c11.value + 2.0 * cp_c12.value) / 3.0 AS bulk_modulus,
    cp_stable.value AS is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_l12 ON cp_l12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_a ON cp_a.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_stable ON cp_stable.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp_l12.property_name = 'L12'
  AND cp_l12.value = 1
  AND cp_a.property_name = 'lattice_a'
  AND cp_c11.property_name = 'C11'
  AND cp_c12.property_name = 'C12'
  AND cp_c44.property_name = 'C44'
  AND cp_stable.property_name = 'is_stable'
  AND cp_stable.value = 1
ORDER BY
    ABS(cp_a.value - 3.57) ASC,
    (cp_c11.value + 2.0 * cp_c12.value) / 3.0 DESC,
    cp_c44.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_stable ON cp_stable.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_l12 ON cp_l12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE m.formula LIKE '%Co%'
  AND cp_stable.property_name = 'is_stable'
  AND cp_stable.value = 1
  AND cp_l12.property_name = 'prototype_L12'
  AND cp_l12.value = 1
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.formula = 'Co3Ti'
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0 AND ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 'Q1_negative_formation_energy_stable'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0 AND ps.is_stable = FALSE THEN 'Q2_negative_formation_energy_unstable'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom >= 0 AND ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 'Q3_positive_formation_energy_stable'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom >= 0 AND ps.is_stable = FALSE THEN 'Q4_positive_formation_energy_unstable'
  END AS stability_quadrant
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
ORDER BY stability_quadrant ASC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,

FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_lat ON cp_lat.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id

  AND m.chemical_system LIKE '%Ni%'
  AND m.chemical_system <> 'Al-Ni'
ORDER BY ABS(cp_lat.value - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
JOIN calculated_property cp_stab ON cp_stab.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_stab.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
WHERE m.formula <> 'Ni3Al'
  AND cp_stab.value < (
      SELECT cp_ref_stab.value
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN calculated_property cp_ref_stab ON cp_ref_stab.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id
      WHERE m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al'
        AND cp_ref_stab.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
      ORDER BY cp_ref_stab.value ASC
      LIMIT 1
  )
  AND cp_bm.value > (
      SELECT cp_ref_bm.value
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN calculated_property cp_ref_bm ON cp_ref_bm.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id
      WHERE m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al'
        AND cp_ref_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
      ORDER BY cp_ref_bm.value DESC
      LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY cp_bm.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    cp_stability.value AS stability_score,
    cp_lattice.value AS lattice_matching_score,
    cp_elastic.value AS elastic_score,
    cp_stability.value * cp_lattice.value * cp_elastic.value AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_l12 ON cp_l12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_stability ON cp_stability.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_lattice ON cp_lattice.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_elastic ON cp_elastic.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp_l12.property_name = 'is_l12'
  AND cp_l12.value = 1
  AND cp_stability.property_name = 'stability_score'
  AND cp_lattice.property_name = 'lattice_matching_score'
  AND cp_elastic.property_name = 'elastic_score'
ORDER BY composite_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
GROUP BY m.formula
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.chemical_system = 'Ni'
   OR m.chemical_system LIKE 'Ni-%'
   OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-Ni'
   OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-Ni-%'
ORDER BY m.formula ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.1
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;
